label: Frankfurt School combined Marxist critique with Freudian psychoanalysis and culture critique
description: Theodor W. Adorno adopted Karl Marx's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Karl Marx's perspective to Theodor W. Adorno's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 19th Century Divergences across history into the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis.

label: Formulated and introduced Historical Materialism & Alienation
description: Karl Marx formulated and introduced the concept of "Historical Materialism & Alienation", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 19th Century Divergences as part of Karl Marx's canonical writings.
